description: E32 — 链接双车 - 第7局：争夺开放列（尼姆佐-印度防御）

intro.popup_en:
Connect the Rooks, Practice 7
The exchange opens the d-file, and both sides want to occupy it. White connects the rooks first, then immediately contests the key files.
intro.popup:
链接双车练习7
兑换后d列开放——白方和黑方都想抢占！
白方率先完成双车连接，立刻争夺关键列！

outro.popup_en: Summary: Rfe1 and Rad1 control the e- and d-files. Connect the rooks first, then claim the open files.
outro.popup:
总结：Rfe1，Rad1 = e、d两列全控！
先完成连接，再抢占开放列，很好的步调！

moves.popup_en: O-O! White completes the castling plan and connects the rooks. The next step is to contest the d-file.
moves.popup:
O-O！三步曲完成！双车连接！
计划：立刻争夺d列！

moves.popup_en: dxe5! The exchange opens the d-file.
Rfe1! The rook moves from f1 to e1, activating on the e-file and preparing to contest the d-file as well.
moves.popup:
Rfe1！Rf1→e1！
激活：车进e列，准备再争d列！

moves.popup_en: ...Qe7 connects Black's queen with the pieces.
Rad1!! White completes the setup: one rook controls the e-file and the other the d-file. White has achieved full control of both files.
moves.popup:
Rad1！！最终形态！
双列控制完成：
Re1（e列）+ Rd1（d列）
白方全面领先！
